about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Olive Oil and Orange Cake
recipes.summary: A fragrant, tender dairy-free cake made with good olive oil and fresh orange.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan) and line a 22cm tin.
Whisk the eggs and sugar for 3 minutes, until pale, then whisk in the oil, orange juice and zest.
Fold in the flour and baking powder until just combined and pour into the tin.
Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean. Cool and dust with icing sugar.

recipes.title: Honey Pears with Vanilla Mascarpone Cream
recipes.summary: Pears simmered in honey and vanilla, served with softly whipped mascarpone cream.
steps: Simmer the pears with the honey, half the vanilla and the water in a covered saucepan for 20 minutes, until a knife slides in easily.
Lift out the pears and boil the syrup for 5 minutes, until reduced and glossy.
Whisk the mascarpone, cream, icing sugar and remaining vanilla until soft peaks form.
Serve the pears warm with the cream, a spoonful of syrup and the pistachios.

recipes.title: Rosemary Sea Salt Focaccia
recipes.summary: A deep-dimpled, olive oil-rich loaf with a crisp base and chewy middle.
steps: Stir the flour, yeast, 2 tsp salt, water and 2 tbsp oil in a large bowl to a sticky dough. Cover and rest until doubled.
Pour 2 tbsp oil into a 25 x 35cm tray, tip in the dough and stretch it to the corners. Rest for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Dimple the dough with oiled fingers, drizzle with the remaining oil and scatter with the rosemary and 1 tsp salt.
Bake for 25 minutes, until deep golden. Cool on a rack.
notes: Plus about 2 hours resting and rising.

recipes.title: Almond Cantucci
recipes.summary: Twice-baked Tuscan almond biscuits made for dunking.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a tray.
Mix the flour, sugar and baking powder, then stir in the eggs, zest, vanilla and almonds to a stiff dough.
Shape into two logs 5cm wide on the tray and bake for 25 minutes, until golden.
Cool for 10 minutes, slice diagonally into 1.5cm biscuits, lay cut-side up and bake for 15 minutes more, until dry and crisp.

recipes.title: Pear and Almond Clafoutis
recipes.summary: A custardy baked batter around soft pears, finished with a dusting of sugar.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and butter a 24cm baking dish. Arrange the pears in the dish.
Whisk the eggs and sugar, then whisk in the flour, almond meal, milk, cream and vanilla until smooth.
Pour the batter over the pears and bake for 35 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the centre. Dust with icing sugar and serve warm.

recipes.title: Crème Caramel
recipes.summary: A classic baked custard with a bittersweet caramel that pools around it.
steps: Heat the white sugar and water in a saucepan over medium heat, without stirring, for 8 minutes, until a deep amber caramel forms. Pour quickly into six ramekins.
Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Warm the milk and cream until steaming.
Whisk the whole eggs, yolks, caster sugar and vanilla, then slowly whisk in the warm milk. Strain into the ramekins.
Set the ramekins in a deep roasting dish and pour in boiling water to halfway up their sides. Bake for 40 minutes, until set with a slight wobble and the custard reaches 75°C.
Cool, chill, then run a knife around the edge and turn out onto plates.
notes: Food safety: bake the custard until it reaches 75°C so the egg is fully cooked.

recipes.title: Crema Catalana
recipes.summary: Cinnamon and lemon-scented custard under a crackling burnt sugar crust.
steps: Heat the milk with the lemon zest and cinnamon stick until steaming, then take off the heat and infuse for 15 minutes.
Whisk the yolks, caster sugar and cornflour until pale, then strain in the hot milk.
Return to the pan and stir over low heat for 6 minutes, until thick and reaching 75°C. Pour into six shallow dishes and chill.
Sprinkle with the white sugar and caramelise with a blowtorch or under a very hot grill until bubbling and amber.
notes: Food safety: heat the custard to 75°C so the yolks are fully cooked.

recipes.title: Lemon Olive Oil Polvorones
recipes.summary: Crumbly Spanish shortbreads made with olive oil and almond.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan) and line a tray.
Toast the flour in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, until pale gold, then cool.
Stir the flour, almond meal, oil, 1/3 cup icing sugar and the lemon zest into a soft dough.
Roll into 24 balls, flatten slightly and bake for 20 minutes, until just coloured. Cool on the tray, then dust with the remaining icing sugar.

recipes.title: Honey Loukoumades
recipes.summary: Crisp-shelled, fluffy Greek doughnut puffs drenched in warm honey and cinnamon.
steps: Whisk the flour, yeast, sugar, salt and warm water to a thick, sticky batter. Cover and rest until doubled and bubbling.
Heat the oil in a deep pot to 180°C. Drop in tablespoons of batter, using a wet spoon, and fry for 3 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper towel, then toss with the warm honey and finish with cinnamon and walnuts.
notes: Vegan if you swap the honey for maple syrup.

recipes.title: Walnut Baklava Bites
recipes.summary: Crisp layers of buttery filo with a cinnamon walnut filling and a lemon honey syrup.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Mix the walnuts, caster sugar, cinnamon and cloves.
Brush a 20cm square tin with butter and layer in 4 sheets of filo, brushing each with butter and trimming to fit. Scatter over half the filling.
Add 4 more buttered sheets and the rest of the filling, then finish with the last 4 sheets, buttering the top.
Cut into 12 squares and bake for 40 minutes, until deep golden.
Simmer the white sugar, honey, water and lemon juice for 8 minutes, until syrupy. Pour the cooled syrup over the hot baklava.
notes: Keep the filo covered with a damp cloth while you work.
Plus 3 hours standing so the syrup soaks in.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Triangles
recipes.summary: Crisp filo parcels of spinach, feta and dill.

items: 300g frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps: Mix the spinach, feta, egg, spring onion and dill.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the filo into long strips, brush with butter and place a spoonful of filling at one end.
Fold each strip over the filling like a flag, working down the strip into a triangle. Place seam-side down on a lined tray and brush with butter.
Bake for 25 minutes, until crisp and deep golden.

recipes.title: Roasted Capsicum and Walnut Muhammara
recipes.summary: A smoky, tangy Syrian dip with roasted capsicum, walnuts and pomegranate molasses.
steps: Blitz the capsicum, walnuts, breadcrumbs, molasses, garlic, cumin, chilli and salt in a food processor until almost smooth.
With the motor running, stream in the oil until thick and spoonable.
Taste and season, then serve with flatbread or raw vegetables.
notes: Vegan. Use gluten-free breadcrumbs or a spoonful of ground almonds to keep it gluten-free.

recipes.title: Coconut Semolina Cake with Lemon Syrup
recipes.summary: A moist, golden semolina and coconut cake cut into diamonds and soaked in syrup.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and grease a 20cm square tin.
Mix the semolina, coconut, flour, caster sugar and baking powder, then stir in the yoghurt and butter to a thick batter.
Spread into the tin, cut into 12 diamonds and press an almond into each. Bake for 35 minutes, until golden.
Meanwhile simmer the white sugar, water and lemon juice for 8 minutes, until syrupy, then stir in the rose water. Pour the cooled syrup over the hot cake.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Orange Salad with Honey
recipes.summary: Chilled orange slices with cinnamon, honey and a little mint, a light Moroccan finish to a meal.

items: 4 orange, peeled and sliced into rounds

steps: Arrange the orange slices on a platter.
Drizzle with the honey, sprinkle with cinnamon, then chill until cold.
Scatter with the mint and pistachios to serve.

recipes.title: Beghrir with Honey Butter
recipes.summary: Moroccan thousand-hole semolina pancakes, cooked on one side only.
steps: Blend the semolina, flour, yeast, baking powder, sugar, salt and water until very smooth. Rest for 20 minutes, until bubbly.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and pour in a small ladle of batter, cooking one side only for 2 minutes, until the top is covered in tiny holes and set.
Slide out onto a clean tea towel and repeat with the remaining batter.
Melt the butter with the honey until smooth and serve poured over the pancakes.

recipes.title: Classic Victoria Sponge
recipes.summary: Two light butter cake layers sandwiched with jam and whipped cream.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two 20cm tins.
Beat the butter and sugar for 4 minutes, until pale and fluffy, then beat in the eggs one at a time. Fold in the flour, milk and vanilla.
Divide between the tins and bake for 25 minutes, until golden and springy to the touch. Cool completely.
Spread one layer with jam and the whipped cream, sandwich with the second and dust with icing sugar.

recipes.title: Buttery Shortbread Fingers
recipes.summary: Three-ingredient shortbread with a sandy, melting crumb.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan) and line a 20 x 30cm tin.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, then work in the flour to a soft dough. Press into the tin and prick with a fork.
Score into 24 fingers and bake for 25 minutes, until pale gold. Sprinkle with the extra sugar, recut along the lines while warm and cool in the tin.

recipes.title: Bread and Butter Pudding
recipes.summary: Buttered bread baked in a vanilla custard with sultanas until puffed and golden.
steps: Butter the bread, cut into triangles and layer in a 2-litre baking dish with the sultanas.
Whisk the eggs, milk, cream, sugar and vanilla and pour over the bread. Rest for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan), sprinkle the top with nutmeg and bake for 40 minutes, until golden and the custard is set.
notes: Food safety: bake until the custard is set in the middle, with no liquid egg.

recipes.title: Herby Pork Sausage Rolls
recipes.summary: Flaky pastry around a herby pork and onion filling.
steps: Mix the pork, onion, breadcrumbs, egg, thyme, salt and pepper until well combined.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the pastry into 6 even rectangles, spoon a log of filling along each and roll up with the seam underneath.
Cut into 4 pieces each, brush with egg yolk and scatter with sesame seeds.
Bake on lined trays for 30 minutes, until golden and the filling reaches 75°C in the centre.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink inside.

recipes.title: Cheddar and Chive Scones
recipes.summary: Savoury scones with sharp cheddar, great warm with butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and flour a tray.
Rub the butter into the flour and salt, then stir in most of the cheddar and the chives.
Add the milk and cut it in with a knife to a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick and cut into rounds.
Top with the last of the cheese and bake for 18 minutes, until risen and golden.

recipes.title: Almond Linzer Biscuits
recipes.summary: Buttery almond biscuits sandwiched with raspberry jam and a cut-out window.
steps: Beat the butter and 1/2 cup icing sugar until pale, then beat in the yolk and vanilla. Stir in the flour and almond meal to a soft dough, wrap and chill.
Heat the oven to 170°C (150°C fan). Roll the dough 3mm thick, cut 6cm rounds and cut a small window out of half of them.
Bake on lined trays for 12 minutes, until pale golden. Cool completely.
Dust the window biscuits with icing sugar, spread the others with jam and sandwich together.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzel Bites
recipes.summary: Chewy, mahogany pretzel nuggets with coarse salt, dipped in mustard.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and butter, then knead for 8 minutes, until smooth. Cover and rise until doubled.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Roll the dough into ropes and cut into 3cm pieces.
Boil 2 litres of water with the bicarbonate of soda, then poach the pieces in batches for 30 seconds each, until puffed. Lift out onto a lined tray.
Brush with egg yolk, sprinkle with sea salt and bake for 15 minutes, until deep brown. Serve with mustard.
notes: Vegetarian. Handle the bicarbonate water carefully, as it is caustic.

recipes.title: Pavlova with Berries and Cream
recipes.summary: A crisp-shelled, marshmallowy meringue piled with cream and berries.
steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan) and draw a 20cm circle on baking paper.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoonful at a time, whisking for 8 minutes, until thick, glossy and the sugar has dissolved. Fold in the vinegar, cornflour and vanilla.
Pile into the circle, make a dip in the middle and reduce the oven to 120°C (100°C fan). Bake for 75 minutes, until crisp outside, then turn off the oven and cool inside with the door ajar.
Top with the cream and berries just before serving.
notes: Plus 2 hours cooling in the oven.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Scones
recipes.summary: Soft golden scones made with mashed pumpkin, a Queensland classic.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and flour a tray.
Beat the mash, 30g butter, sugar and egg in a bowl, then fold in the flour and enough milk to form a soft dough.
Pat out 2.5cm thick, cut into rounds and place close together on the tray.
Bake for 18 minutes, until risen and golden, then brush with the extra butter.

recipes.title: Coconut Oat Bliss Balls
recipes.summary: No-bake energy bites with oats, peanut butter and a pinch of salt.
steps: Mix the oats, peanut butter, maple syrup, 1/4 cup coconut, cocoa and salt in a bowl until the mixture holds together.
Roll heaped teaspoons of the mixture into 18 even balls, pressing firmly so they hold.
Roll the balls in the remaining coconut and chill until firm.
notes: Vegan. Use certified gluten-free oats to keep it gluten-free.

recipes.title: Apple Crumble Bars
recipes.summary: A buttery oat base and crumble top sandwiching cinnamon apple.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line a 20cm square tin.
Mix the flour, oats, brown sugar, 1/2 tsp cinnamon and bicarbonate of soda, then stir in the butter until crumbly. Press two-thirds into the tin.
Toss the apple with the caster sugar, lemon juice and remaining cinnamon and spread over the base, then crumble the rest of the oat mix on top.
Bake for 40 minutes, until golden and the apple is tender. Cool before cutting.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chunk Cookies
recipes.summary: Big chewy cookies with crisp edges and pools of dark chocolate.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan) and line two trays.
Beat the butter and both sugars until creamy, then beat in the egg and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, bicarbonate of soda and salt, then fold in the chocolate.
Scoop 12 mounds onto the trays and bake for 12 minutes, until golden at the edges but soft in the centre. Cool on the tray for 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Buffalo Cauliflower Bites
recipes.summary: Crisp-coated cauliflower tossed in a hot, tangy buffalo glaze.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Whisk the flour, water, garlic powder and paprika to a smooth batter.
Coat the florets in the batter and spread on a lined tray. Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Whisk the hot sauce and melted butter, toss the florets in it and bake for 5 minutes more, until sticky.
Stir the chives into the yoghurt and serve alongside as a dip.

recipes.title: Classic Deviled Eggs
recipes.summary: Creamy, tangy egg yolk filling piped into halved boiled eggs.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until the whites and yolks are fully set, then cool in iced water and peel.
Halve the eggs and scoop the yolks into a bowl. Mash with the mayonnaise, mustard and vinegar until smooth.
Pipe or spoon the filling back into the whites and finish with the paprika and chives.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set and keep them chilled until serving; eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Charred Corn Esquites
recipes.summary: Street-style corn cut from the cob and tossed with lime, mayo and chilli.
steps: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the corn for 8 minutes, stirring rarely, until charred in spots.
Toss the hot corn with the mayonnaise, lime juice and chilli powder.
Fold through the feta and coriander and serve warm.

recipes.title: Chunky Guacamole with Corn Chips
recipes.summary: Lime-spiked mashed avocado with tomato, onion and coriander.
steps: Mash the avocado roughly in a bowl, leaving some chunks.
Stir in the onion, tomato, coriander, lime juice, jalapeño and salt.
Taste and add more lime or salt until it is bright and well seasoned, then serve straight away with the corn chips.
notes: Press cling wrap onto the surface to stop it browning if you make it ahead.

recipes.title: Brazilian Cheese Puffs
recipes.summary: Chewy, gluten-free cheese puffs made with tapioca starch.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan) and line a tray.
Heat the milk, oil and salt until just boiling, then pour over the tapioca starch and mix until smooth and cool for 10 minutes.
Beat in the egg and cheese to a sticky dough, roll into 24 balls and place on the tray.
Bake for 25 minutes, until puffed and golden.
notes: Best eaten warm on the day.

recipes.title: Baked Beef Empanadas
recipes.summary: Golden pastry half-moons with a spiced beef, olive and egg filling.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until set, then cool, peel and chop.

Cook the onion in a frying pan for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the mince, garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and the mince is cooked through. Stir in the tomato paste, olives and chopped egg and cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut 12 rounds of pastry, fill, fold into half-moons and crimp the edges.
Brush with egg yolk and bake on lined trays for 25 minutes, until golden.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C right through before filling; the filled pies should be steaming hot in the centre.

recipes.title: Rum Glazed Grilled Pineapple
recipes.summary: Caramelised pineapple rings with a rum and brown sugar glaze.

items: 800g pineapple, peeled and cut into thick rings

steps: Mix the rum, sugar, cinnamon and coconut oil and brush over the pineapple rings.
Cook in a hot griddle pan for 4 minutes each side, until deeply caramelised and charred in stripes.
Spoon over any remaining glaze and serve warm.

recipes.title: Caribbean Johnny Cakes
recipes.summary: Golden pan-fried dumplings that are crisp outside and soft within.
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then rub in the butter until the mixture looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the coconut milk to a soft dough, knead briefly and divide into 6. Flatten into discs.
Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the cakes for 6 minutes each side, until deep golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Feta Frittata
recipes.summary: A thick, baked frittata with soft zucchini and salty feta.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Whisk the eggs, milk and salt, then stir in the zucchini, feta, spring onion and basil.
Heat the oil in a 24cm ovenproof frying pan over medium heat, pour in the mixture and cook for 3 minutes, until the edge starts to set.
Bake for 25 minutes, until puffed, golden and set in the centre.
notes: Food safety: the eggs must be fully set in the centre.

recipes.title: Tomato Bruschetta Trio
recipes.summary: Crisp garlic toast with three vibrant toppings: tomato, white bean and olive.
steps: Toast or grill the bread until golden, then rub with the cut garlic.
Toss the tomato with the basil and 1 tbsp oil. Mash the beans roughly with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp oil. Mix the olives with the capers and 1 tbsp oil.
Spoon each topping onto bread slices, drizzle with the remaining oil and serve straight away.

recipes.title: Minestrone with Pesto Swirl
recipes.summary: A thick vegetable and bean soup finished with a spoon of basil pesto.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and celery in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans, pasta and zucchini and cook for 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Ladle into bowls and top with a spoonful of pesto.
notes: Vegetarian: check the pesto label for a vegetarian hard cheese.

recipes.title: Ratatouille Tartines
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked Provençal vegetables piled on toasted sourdough.
steps: Cook the eggplant in 2 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, until golden. Set aside.
Cook the zucchini, capsicum and onion in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and herbs for 1 minute.
Return the eggplant, add the tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick and jammy.
Toast the sourdough until golden and spoon over the ratatouille.

recipes.title: Garlic Prawns on Toast
recipes.summary: Sizzling prawns in garlicky chilli oil, mopped up with grilled bread.
steps: Warm the oil, garlic and chilli flakes in a frying pan over medium heat for 2 minutes, until the garlic is fragrant but not browned.
Add the prawns and paprika and cook for 3 minutes, turning once, until the prawns are pink and opaque.
Stir in the lemon juice and parsley. Grill the bread until golden and spoon the prawns and oil over.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until opaque and pink right through, about 63°C, and don't reuse leftovers more than a day later.

recipes.title: Smoky Garlic Chickpeas with Wilted Greens
recipes.summary: A smoky Andalusian-style stew of chickpeas, spinach and cumin.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil in a large pot over medium heat for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and 1 cup water and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Stir through the spinach until wilted, then add the vinegar.

recipes.title: Chicken Gyro Pita Wraps
recipes.summary: Lemon oregano chicken in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato and onion.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, lemon juice, garlic and oregano and rest while the pan heats.
Cook in a hot frying pan for 10 minutes, turning, until browned and the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Warm the pita, spread with tzatziki and fill with the chicken, tomato and onion.
notes: Plus 30 minutes marinating, if you have time.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink meat.

recipes.title: Fakes Greek Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, earthy lentil soup with garlic, bay and a splash of red wine vinegar.
steps: Cook the onion and carrot in 2 tbsp oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, bay leaves, tomatoes and stock and simmer for 35 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the soup is thick.
Stir in the vinegar and drizzle with the remaining oil.

recipes.title: Falafel Bowls with Tahini Sauce
recipes.summary: Crisp baked falafel on rice and salad with a lemony tahini drizzle.
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs and spices in a food processor until coarse. Stir in the flour and bicarbonate of soda and shape into 16 balls.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush with the oil and bake on a lined tray for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and 3 tbsp water until pourable. Serve the falafel over rice with the tomato, cucumber and sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Flatbread Rolls
recipes.summary: Spiced, charred chicken wrapped with garlic sauce, pickles and salad.
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, spices and garlic.
Cook in a hot frying pan for 12 minutes, turning, until charred in spots and the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with toum and fill with the chicken, cucumber, tomato and pickled turnip.
notes: Plus 30 minutes marinating, if you have time.
Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink meat.

recipes.title: Harira Chickpea and Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: A fragrant Moroccan tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Cook the onion and celery in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lentils, chickpeas and stock and simmer for 30 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Break the vermicelli into the pot and cook for 5 minutes, until tender, then finish with coriander and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Jacket Potato with Beans and Cheese
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned baked potatoes filled with baked beans and melted cheddar.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the potatoes with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 minutes, until the skin is crisp and the flesh is soft.
Warm the beans in a saucepan until steaming.
Split the potatoes, mash in the butter, then top with the beans and cheddar. Grill for 2 minutes, until bubbling.

recipes.title: Cheesy Tuna Toasties
recipes.summary: A creamy tuna and cheddar filling grilled between crisp slices of bread.
steps: Mix the tuna, mayonnaise, spring onion and lemon juice.
Spoon over two slices of bread, top with the cheddar and the other slices, then butter the outsides.
Cook in a frying pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and the cheese has melted.
notes: Food safety: tinned tuna is cooked; keep opened tins chilled and use within 2 days.

recipes.title: Black Bean Quesadillas
recipes.summary: Crisp tortillas oozing with black beans, corn and melted cheese.
steps: Mash half the beans roughly and mix with the whole beans, corn, cumin and coriander.
Spread over two tortillas, scatter with the cheese and top with the remaining tortillas.
Cook in a dry frying pan over medium heat for 4 minutes each side, until golden and the cheese has melted. Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
